description: Example of a cover scene stored in separate cover.json file. Covers are NOT stored inside chapters — they live in the book root directory as a dedicated cover.json file. The type field must be "cover". Each cover typically has a single typography unit with a text_render visual for the book title and author.
notes: Cover is NOT a scene inside any chapter — it is a standalone file
Cover always has 1 typography unit with visual.text_render: true
The system generates Cover image first, before the selected generation range

visual.prompt: full frame book cover design, vertical composition, classic russian literature aesthetic, elegant serif typography, top small text: author name, center large text: book title, dark background with golden accents, cinematic mood
visual.quality: highly detailed, sharp typography, clean composition
